lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. Three primary rows are distinguishable, with the largest and most intense centroids located in the medial row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run perpendicular to the body axis, intersecting with the horizontal rows of blobs to create a rectilinear grid-like appearance.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from light pixels above to a shadowed, lower-intensity region below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, uniform high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more closely packed than those found on the lateral flank.
